Words: 你什么时候进来的？
When did you come in?
最后一句。Morrison 让你在这里等？
The last line. Morrison told you to wait here?
等他回来带我走。
For him to come back and take me away.
所以你还是唱了。
So you sang anyway.
嗯。
Yes.
一个观众也没有。
Not a single person in the audience.
本来就不是唱给他们的。
It wasn't for them in the first place.
我记得。
I remember.
别给旧东西编故事。我和 Webb 不是恋人，我只是他勒索别人的工具。
Do not invent a story for an old photograph. Webb and I were not lovers. I was only a tool he used to blackmail others.
歌唱完了。你不是来听歌的。
The song is over. You didn't come here to listen.
我想问几个你上次没有回答的问题。
I want to ask about a few things you didn't answer last time.
你问吧。
Go ahead.

Parameters.ParameterStr: Rosa 对你的指认已经被推翻。你为什么还坚持认罪？
Parameters.ParameterEn: Rosa’s accusation has been disproved. Why do you still insist on confessing?

Parameters.ParameterStr: 这张合照为什么一直留在抽屉里？
Parameters.ParameterEn: Why did you keep this photograph in your drawer?

Words: Rosa 的指认已经站不住了。她没有看见你开枪，十一点半那声也不是致命枪声。
Rosa's accusation no longer holds. She never saw you fire, and the shot at half past eleven was not the fatal one.
你真的进去了吗？
Did you actually go in?
那又怎么样？
What difference does that make?
我不知道。那一段很模糊。枪、音乐，还有后来倒在地上的 Webb，全混在了一起。
I don't know. That part is blurred. The gun, the music, and Webb lying on the floor afterward have all run together.
十一点以后，你做了什么？
What did you do after eleven?
十点到十一点，我一直在台上。十一点，我的演出结束。后面是乐队。
From ten to eleven, I was onstage. At eleven, my set ended. The band took over.
我让乐队在十一点接上 Webb 最喜欢的那首。
I told the band to follow my set at eleven with Webb's favorite song.
你准备趁他们演奏的时候进入会客室。
You meant to enter the parlor while they played.
23:05，我带着枪走到会客室，原本打算直接进去找 Webb。
At 23:05, I went to the parlor with a gun. I had meant to go straight in and find Webb.
你原本打算进去做什么？
What did you intend to do once you went in?
我要带他去跳最后一支舞。等舞曲结束，再杀了他。
I would take him for one last dance. When the music ended, I would kill him.
照片右下角写着“Ashford，1924”。为什么锁在你的私人抽屉里？
The lower-right corner says “Ashford, 1924.” Why was it locked in your private drawer?
四年前，我在 Ashford 的台上唱歌时认识了 Webb。
I met Webb four years ago, when I was singing on a stage in Ashford.
今年是 1928。你把它留了四年。
It is 1928. You kept it for four years.
忘了扔。
I forgot to throw it away.
四年。忘掉一张照片，用不了这么久。
Four years. It doesn't take that long to forget one photograph.
你到底想从一张照片里问出什么？
What exactly do you expect to get out of one photograph?
它至少证明，四年前你们就不只是普通的老板和歌女。可从上次见面开始，你就一直不肯让我们问这段关系。
At least it proves that four years ago, you were more than an employer and a singer. Yet you have refused to let us ask about that relationship.
昨天你说，这一首是唱给自己的。为什么非得在被带走以前唱完？
Yesterday you said this song was for yourself. Why did you have to finish it before they took you away?
Rita，她来了之后，Webb就不再怎么和我待在一起了。
Rita. After she arrived, Webb hardly spent any time with me.
四年前，我以为只要一直唱，总有一天就能离开 Ashford。
Four years ago, I thought that if I kept singing, one day I would get out of Ashford.
后来 Webb 把舞台变成了挑选目标的地方。
Then Webb turned the stage into a place for choosing targets.
陪客人喝酒，听他们说秘密，再把那些话带回去。唱歌反而成了最不重要的部分。
Drink with the guests, listen to their secrets, bring those secrets back. Singing became the least important part.
所以你真正想要的，是唱完以后不必再端着酒盘走进某个客人的包厢。
So what you really wanted was to finish a song without having to carry a tray into some guest's booth afterward.
……你非得把梦想说得这么难听吗？
...Do you have to make a dream sound so ugly?
难听的通常比较接近实话。
The ugly version is usually closer to the truth.
至少刚才这一首，只是因为我想唱。
At least that last song was simply because I wanted to sing.
歌已经唱完了。你也该走了。
The song is over. You should go too.
记不清，不等于你开了枪。
Not remembering is not the same as having fired.
可就算 Webb 不是十一点半死的，也只能是我。
But even if Webb didn't die at half past eleven, it still had to be me.

Parameters.ParameterStr: Rosa 对你的指认已经被推翻。你为什么还坚持认罪？
Parameters.ParameterEn: Rosa’s accusation has been disproved. Why do you still insist on confessing?

Parameters.ParameterStr: 这张合照为什么一直留在抽屉里？
Parameters.ParameterEn: Why did you keep this photograph in your drawer?

Words: 为什么？
Why?
Webb 防着所有人。能在他毫无防备时接近他的，除了我，只有他身边那几个得力助手。
Webb was wary of everyone. Other than me, only a few of his trusted lieutenants could approach him while his guard was down.
可他们靠 Webb 吃饭，没有理由杀他。只有我有。
But they depended on Webb. They had no reason to kill him. I did.
不。你只是不知道他们的理由。
No. You just don't know their reasons.
有区别吗？
Is there a difference?
有。你没有想起自己开枪，只是因为想不到别人为什么开枪，就替凶手认了罪。
There is. You didn't remember firing. You just couldn't imagine why anyone else would, so you confessed for the killer.
我带着枪去过，也确实想杀他。
I went there with a gun. I really did want to kill him.
那证明你有计划，不能证明你完成了它。
That proves you had a plan. It doesn't prove you carried it out.
……可我真的想不起来了。
...But I truly can't remember.
Webb 最近常和 Rita 待在一起。你认识她吗？
Webb had been spending a great deal of time with Rita. Do you know her?
不认识。
No.
你回答得太快了。
You answered too quickly.
因为没什么好认识的。那个女人一出现，Webb 的心思就全跟着她走了。
Because there was nothing worth knowing. The moment that woman appeared, Webb’s attention followed her everywhere.
你是说，他因为 Rita 改变了原来的安排。
You mean he changed his previous plans because of Rita.
我没这么说。
I did not say that.
那原来的安排是什么？
Then what were the previous plans?
……我不想谈她。
...I do not want to talk about her.
